title: 摸摸开工
brief: Nailü drowses at flower counter on the right with a single loose bouquet. X on left gently pats her head ONCE with one hand, removes hand. N perks up, instantly gathers the bouquet and cinches pink ribbon; presents it proudly, sets it below counter and relaxes.

board.title: 摸摸开工
poses: 0.00 s: Nailü drowses on the right, cheek in her left palm; her right hand rests beside one loose bouquet and pink ribbon. X stands left, both hands on the counter.
0.55 s: X raises only the right hand above Nailü’s head, keeping the left hand planted; Nailü and the bouquet remain still.
0.95 s: X’s right palm gently contacts Nailü’s crown for one pat; her sleepy eyes turn upward, both hands unchanged.
1.30 s: X withdraws the right hand toward the counter; Nailü straightens brightly, left hand gathering the stems and right hand catching the ribbon.
1.80 s: Nailü grips the gathered stems with her left hand and cinches a pink slip bow with her right; X rests both hands on the counter.
2.50 s: Nailü proudly presents the single tied bouquet at chest height with both hands, smiling toward X; X watches with both hands resting.
3.15 s: Nailü places the bouquet on a visible shelf below the counter, both hands still touching it and eyes following it; X remains still.
3.90 s: Nailü returns the same bouquet to the countertop, left hand spreading its stems while her right pulls the slip bow open; X watches.
4.65 s: Nailü relaxes, eyelids drooping and cheek hovering just above her raised left palm; her right hand rests beside the loose bouquet and ribbon, while X rests both hands.
board.continuity: Keep the camera fixed and counter front open throughout the 4.8-second loop, tracking both characters’ hands and the same bouquet and ribbon as pose nine settles into the distinct, adjacent pose one.
